final240_tradeoff: Both final arms learn Tonight I go makan with my friends on the reused dinner draft, plausibly helped by shared20casual pairs. Revised final also reverses cannot meet before6pm into Meet before six can anot?; late-arrival assurance and7pm/8pm/assignment-refusal failures persist. More updates are not a uniform improvement.
interpretation: Some context-heavy failures suggest rewriting re-answers the incoming message instead of preserving the supplied English; this is a hypothesis from outputs, not a causal finding.
limitations: One seed; assistant-authored target preferences and illustrative cases; old validation and casual demos reused.20casual pairs shared across arms can explain gains in both. Lower CE/copy/particle counts do not establish quality.
next_recommendation: Keep original default and all snapshots. Review full comparison and focus the next design on preserving the English reply when history/incoming conflicts; freeze the next evaluation before any training. No new run submitted for this status request.
